decks.notes: The deck focuses on using aggressive tactics to quickly deploy Death's Shadow and other threats to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. The main strategy involves using low-cost spells like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Hymn to Tourach to control the board and protect key threats like Death's Shadow. Supporting cards like Baleful Strix and brainstorm help with card advantage and consistency, while cards like Fatal Push and Snuff Out provide removal options. Overall, the deck aims to win through a combination of early aggression and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently fill your graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting. Then, you can use reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield, often for a very low cost. By combining graveyard manipulation with powerful reanimation effects, this deck aims to put powerful threats onto the battlefield early in the game and overwhelm your opponent with explosive plays.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, to gain a significant advantage over the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Faithless Looting to enable fast mana acceleration and card filtering, allowing for explosive plays and combos. It also includes disruptive elements like Unmask and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own combo pieces. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful reanimation strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly generating mana with cards like Gaea's Cradle and Heritage Druid, while using Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote to untap creatures and create additional mana. The goal is to chain together a series of low-cost Elves with Glimpse of Nature to draw through the deck and find key combo pieces like Natural Order to tutor out Craterhoof Behemoth for a lethal attack. Allosaurus Shepherd protects key spells from counterspells, while cards like Once Upon a Time provide additional consistency to the deck's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing disruptive cards like Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void, while maintaining pressure with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Elite Spellbinder. The deck aims to establish an early advantage by utilizing mana acceleration through cards like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox, while maintaining control over the game through cards like Solitude and Palace Jailer. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards with the Venture into the Dungeon mechanic to generate additional value and card advantage.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer combo by using Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for the necessary pieces, while also protecting the combo with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and disruptive cards like Mana Tithe. Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid enable fast equipping of Colossus Hammer onto creatures like Ornithopter, turning them into deadly threats. The deck also includes utility lands like Wasteland and Urza's Saga for additional toolbox options, creating a fast and resilient gameplay experience focused on delivering a lethal blow with the powerful combo.

This control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck utilizes powerful cards like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Counterspell to control the board and protect its own threats. Life from the Loam and Prismatic Ending provide some versatility in dealing with different types of threats, while Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath provides card advantage and a resilient threat. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and includes utility lands like Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary.

Utilize fast mana and graveyard manipulation to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, disrupting opponents with cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize. Atraxa, Grand Unifier adds an extra layer of control to the deck, while Faithless Looting helps dig for combo pieces. The goal is to reanimate big threats early in the game and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

The main concept of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tarmogoyf, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to control the board with efficient removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while also generating card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Sylvan Library. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly, while also providing flexibility with cards like Brazen Borrower and Force of Negation.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize disruptive control elements such as discard spells (Thoughtseize, Hymn to Tourach), removal (Innocent Blood, Smallpox), and planeswalkers (Liliana of the Veil, Karn, the Great Creator) to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly grinding them out with resource denial (Wasteland, The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale), mana denial (Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth), and creature removal. The inclusion of cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Cursed Scroll adds additional ways to control the board and win the game.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Cloudpost and Tron lands, while controlling the board with Pithing Needle, Glacial Chasm, and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale. The deck relies on Crop Rotation and Expedition Map to find key lands like Eye of Ugin and Glimmerpost to cheat out big threats like Emrakul, Kozilek, and Ulamog. Elvish Reclaimer and Primeval Titan provide consistency and toolbox options, while Green Sun's Zenith can search for essential creatures. The deck also includes some graveyard hate with Bojuka Bog and Endurance, as well as additional utility lands like Karakas and Cavern of Souls.

The main idea of this Combo - Show and Tell deck is to quickly get out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield by using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Daze to protect its key combo pieces. By utilizing fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with high-powered threats in the Legacy format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Trinisphere, while also deploying aggressive threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Fury to quickly close out the game. With access to powerful red mana acceleration cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and prevent them from stabilizing. By combining disruptive elements with aggressive creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield by casting Show and Tell or using sneak attack. The deck includes ways to manipulate the top of the library with Preordain, Ponder, and Brainstorm, while also including disruption with Force of Will and Daze. The inclusion of cards like Omniscience and Simian Spirit Guide add extra ways to cheat big creatures into play early, making it a fast and explosive combo deck with the potential to win the game quickly.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful mana engine using Cloudpost and Tron lands to ramp into big threats like Primeval Titan and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. Support cards like Crop Rotation and Expedition Map help find key lands, while Pithing Needle and Karakas disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes utility lands like Glacial Chasm and Bojuka Bog for protection and graveyard hate. With strong ramp and control elements, this deck aims to overpower opponents with massive creatures and powerful spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck includes multiple ways to search for and play these combo pieces quickly, such as Green Sun's Zenith, Crop Rotation, and Knight of the Reliquary. Additionally, the deck includes utility cards like Swords to Plowshares and Mox Diamond to control the board and ramp up mana production. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble the Dark Depths combo while disrupting opponents' strategies.
